Differentiate between AI revenue leaders (AVGO, NVDA) and narrative-driven names; set stop-losses on high-multiple AI stocks
Monitor multifamily delinquencies; reduce exposure to subprime consumer lending; favor dividend-paying financials with strong credit metrics

opportunities.recommendation: Position for value retail and pharmacy consolidation

opportunities.recommendation: Lock in short-term fixed income at current rates
opportunities.rationale: 4.35% APY on 18-month CDs available; 10-year near 5% suggests rates may stay elevated; Treasury $6B buyback failed to lower mortgage rates

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce long-duration growth and office REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 5% 10-year + inflation reacceleration creates double whammy; office expenses outgrew revenue since 2021; CRE refinancing risk acute

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge geopolitical/energy risk with gold and defense
defensive_moves.rationale: Iran escalation, Saudi pipeline attack, Houthi threats create asymmetric upside for gold and defense; gold at 1-month low offers entry

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-multiple AI names without revenue validation
defensive_moves.rationale: PANW faces 'higher valuation bar'; speculative AI stocks vulnerable if rates stay elevated; differentiate winners from narrative

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer discretionary and transport exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Diesel at $6/gallon all-time high compresses margins across logistics, retail, and consumer; inflation pass-through limits pricing power

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil at $108 and inflation reacceleration create headwinds. Fed likely to signal hike or hold higher-for-longer. Energy and defense outperform; growth and rate-sensitive sectors under pressure. Volatility elevated on geopolitical headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on AI infrastructure, industrial/logistics, and healthcare (GLP-1). CRE remains bifurcated—industrial strong, office weak. Geopolitical realignment (BRICS) creates medium-term uncertainty but also commodity demand. Higher rates become structural, favoring value and dividend strategies.
